thread:
james: FYI, pushed weights for a 20B MQA model to gs://redwood-weights/prod/20b-mqa-v2. Need quick compatibility check before we add to catalog.

maria: path confirmed. noticed tokenizer's special token mapping differs; eos token is id 50256 in hf config but our tokenizer maps eos->1. might cause extra BOS/EOS in sliding window.

tara: can someone run tokenizer.inspect on the weights and dump vocab head? I can run sliding-window smoke later.

kevin: I'll run the RoPE scale sanity and attention impl diff on my local rig. quick note: this model uses rotary scaling factor 1.2 and GQA config (grouped_attn: 4). we need to ensure KV cache layout matches our MQA assumptions.

james: @kevin ping on PR #487 (tokenizer fallback) — want a quick review, should be small.

kevin: looking. if GQA groups != our runtime's group size we fallback to single-head path; that'll increase latency but safe. need to verify mqa->gqa mapping.

maria: dump of tokenizer head:
```
{ "vocab_size": 50265, "eos_token_id": 50256, "bos_token_id": 1 }
```
I suspect a reserved token shift. Also found some special bytes in merges.

anusha: CI run attached: ci-bot: sliding-window smoke: PASS (latency 48ms), rope-scale-check: WARN (max error 0.7%), attention-impl-compare: FAIL on layer 10 for multihead-shuffle mismatch. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/ci/1939876

tara: layer 10 mismatch maybe due to grouped_attn vs expected reorder. kevin can you dump QKV shapes for layer 10? also include kv cache strides.

kevin: QKV shapes for layer10: Q (bs, heads, seq, dim_h) = (1, 32, 1024, 64) — but runtime expects heads in groups of 8 for GQA. will instrument.

james: agreed next steps: kevin to run reorder patch locally, maria to add tokenizer map fallback, tara to run full sliding-window regression on the sample prompts. I'll coordinate catalog entry once green. tagging @anusha for perf tracking.

anusha: noted, I'll add an alert if latency > 70ms on min-sla.

kevin: quick snippet I used to test reorder:
```
# reorder qkv groups
q = q.view(bs, groups, heads_per_group, seq, dim_h)
q = q.transpose(1,2).contiguous()
```
works for this model locally, pushing branch kevin/mqa-reorder-1939

maria: PR up: #489 tokenizer-fallback-mqa, added mapping and unit tests. small lint fix too.

tara: starting regression run now, will post results in thread.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: build passed for kevin/mqa-reorder-1939, integration tests queued.

james: cool, thanks all :thumbsup:
